description: [roadmap S3.2] The exe's back surface g_image51b068 is modelled as a 16-bit surface of the root's size, zero-filled at first use. Measured only through its effect: every recorded frame whose root is restored from it (the unmoved-camera blit) equals the original within G2 with the same pixels as the frame that filled it, so the copy loses nothing; its own bits were not recorded and its creation in gameMain (`creates the back surface`) was not read for its depth.
needed: record the back surface's DIB (its jgld surface's DC) at a checkpoint
